title: Renew the registration on a vehicle eligible for a concession
summary: Learn how to renew a vehicle registration if you are eligible for a concession.
intro:
If you're eligible for a concession because of your vehicle registration's usage code, you'll need to renew your registration at a Service NSW Centre or by phone.

Note: If you're a pensioner, you may be eligible for a pensioner concession on vehicle registration renewals.
who_can_apply: HAND – Transport for people with a disability
PRIV – Wheelchair modified vehicle (with vehicle condition code V88)
RDWK – Roadwork by a council, park or cemetery trust (or general roadwork)
SCHL – School student driver education vehicle
SURF – Surf Life Saving Club vehicle
TOW – Tow trucks with 'crane and hook' body
Pensioner (may be eligible for a concession)
what_you_need: Form 1193: Declaration of Eligibility for a Registration Concession – PDF
Your registration details (including plate number, found on your renewal notice or digital Certificate of Registration)
Your registration renewal notice (to note your receipt number, unless using Digital Vehicle Registration)
Signed declaration, tax averaging certificate, or tax assessment notice (for primary producer vehicles only)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the Declaration of Eligibility for a Registration Concession PDF form.
Take your completed form and required documents to a service centre.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for a concession?
faqs.a: Concessions are available for specific vehicle usage codes, including ambulance, civil defence, fire fighting, and others listed on the page.

faqs.q: What do I need to renew my registration?
faqs.a: You will need the Declaration of Eligibility for a Registration Concession form, your registration details, your renewal notice, CTP insurance, and a safety inspection report.

faqs.q: How do I renew my registration?
faqs.a: You must download and complete the Declaration of Eligibility for a Registration Concession form, and then take the completed form and required documents to a Service NSW Centre.
